items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Ram' (Ram Ramirez) as a piano player who took Billy Kyle's place, and the interviewer identifies him as the composer of 'Lover Man'. The interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with the composer himself, but rather with the musician Ram Ramirez.

ctx.x: Uh huh. And we had intended to take Billy Kyle's place, who was down in the South Pacific, and we got Ram. on piano -- Kirby got Ram Ramirez. He was a fine piano player.
Yes. And by the way, my first wife, Nita -- he was with Barnet for a while when we were in theatres, and he was stuck for ...
